name: 02142 · Cambridge, MA
findings: ZIP 02142 (Cambridge) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02142 (Cambridge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02142 (Cambridge) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 8 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
